text: The Fed is now signaling possible rate hikes in 2026 while jobs unexpectedly contracted by 23,000 — this stagflationary mix of sticky 3.4% inflation plus weakening employment means the economy could slow further without the Fed being able to cut rates to help.
Trim BE while you reassess — down 14% with bearish technicals, insider selling, and 8% short interest means this stock is under real pressure and could fall further before stabilizing.

Add to META on this pullback — at a PE of just 15.6 with 22% revenue growth and strong free cash flow, it's genuinely cheap for a business of this quality and should hold up well even in a slowing economy.

Add to GOOGL — trading at a reasonable PE of 23 with 15% revenue growth, healthy free cash flow, and insider buying, this is exactly the kind of quality compounder you want to own heading into uncertainty.
Add to MSFT — at a PE of 20 with 18% revenue growth, consistent earnings beats, and rock-solid cash flow, Microsoft is one of the safest ways to stay invested in tech right now.
